description: Structured resolution inputs derived by hand from datasets/samples/hard_cases.jsonl. The exact match module consumes already separated fields, so this file stands in for the document intelligence stage that will produce them later. scope values: in_scope means the case is covered by exact matching and must pass; deferred_xfail means the case cannot pass at this stage and runs as a strict expected failure; out_of_scope_skip means no structured input can be derived at this stage.
expected_status_mapping: hard case VERIFIED maps to resolution_status MATCHED, hard case NEED_REVIEW maps to requires_review true, hard case NOT_FOUND maps to resolution_status NOT_FOUND

cases.note: Exact matching correctly abstains. The fuzzy milestone should additionally propose Cong an Quan Cau Giay as a near miss candidate.
